why: B covers every piece the client named in black and dark wood: a dark desk, an ergonomic chair, a low bookcase, a task lamp and a leather lounge chair for reading. A's half-moon bookcase is only 8 cm deep, so it cannot work as a low bookcase against the wall. Its reception armchair is a bulky office-waiting piece rather than a small reading chair, and its warm walnut desk with hairpin legs does not match the sober black-and-gray palette.
